partnership_announcements.description: SpinLaunch entered into a partnership with Equinix to deploy its ultra-compact teleports across Equinix’s global network of data centers, forming the ground infrastructure for the Meridian LEO satellite constellation and enabling secure, low-latency connectivity for enterprise, telecom, and government users.

partnership_announcements.description: SpinLaunch announced a partnership with Kongsberg NanoAvionics, securing a satellite bus contract to build the Meridian Space LEO broadband constellation.

press_references.value: NanoAvionics secures funding to build 280 LEO satellites

partnership_announcements.description: SpinLaunch has partnered with NanoAvionics to develop and produce 280 LEO satellites for the Meridian Space constellation. This partnership involves a contract valued at 122.5M EUR and includes the development of two prototypes, with an IOD mission scheduled for 2026.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: SpinLaunch is researching circular mass accelerator systems for off world applications, including a base and vertical support assembly, drive systems, and a rotating shaft configured for kinetic launch. It is also developing ruggedized avionics assemblies with stiffening frames capable of surviving extreme acceleration on kinetically launched space vehicles. Together, these efforts focus on kinetic launch infrastructure and high g tolerant flight electronics.

overview_description.description: SpinLaunch is a space technology company pioneering a new era of scalable space infrastructure. Following years of innovation in alternative launch systems, we’re now applying that same disruptive mindset to orbit - developing Meridian Space, a ground-breaking broadband satellite constellation built for rapid deployment and low-cost global coverage. With backing from industry leaders, SpinLaunch is positioned to deliver a fully integrated ecosystem of launch, satellite, and connectivity services.
